function.name: apply_layout
function.description: Apply a saved layout preset to the Mason desktop app when the user asks to rearrange the workspace. Built-ins: default (chat + sidebars), focus (chat only), terminal-deck, quad; plugin/user presets by id. To reveal ONE pane, use focus_pane instead.

preset.description: Layout preset id to apply (e.g. 'default', 'focus', 'terminal-deck', 'quad', or a user/plugin preset id).
